a.xlink:title: Constructs a display widget for an Archidekt deck.
Attach or detach a card to/from another card.
Move a card between zones and/or players.
Finds the topmost card in a given zone, considering attachments and Z-order.
Displays the enlarged version of the card's pixmap near the cursor.
Access the singleton instance of CardPictureLoader.

Clears the network disk cache of the worker.
Creates and shows the card-overlay context menu.
Retrieve a card pixmap, either from cache or enqueued for loading.

Asks for an image file and installs it as the card's custom art.
